items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Babe Ruth and Earl Sander, the great jockey. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Well, they called it Jamaica in them days.

ctx.x: But that same neighborhood is where the White sportsmen used to live. Babe Ruth and Earl Sander, the great jockey. And I think I told you about Fats Waller was the first Black man to move into that St. Albans neighborhood.
Yeah. Well, they called it Jamaica in them days.
